profile.name: Kulasekara Pandian K R
profile.title: Mechatronics
profile.subtitle: Specializing in Autonomous Robotics, Embedded Firmware, Control Systems & Precision Mechanical CAD
bio: I am a passionate Mechatronics Engineer working at the intersection of precision mechanical design, embedded real-time firmware, and autonomous robotics software.

My engineering approach emphasizes mathematical modeling, rapid prototyping, and end-to-end hardware-software integration. From architecting high-torque cycloidal actuators in CAD to implementing state-space control algorithms on ARM Cortex-M microcontrollers and deploying ROS2 navigation stacks, I build robust, high-performance physical systems.
profile.engineeringPhilosophy: Hardware without software is static; software without hardware is abstract. True engineering mastery lies in the seamless synthesis of dynamics, circuits, and computation.
profile.location: Colombo, Sri Lanka (Open to Global Relocation / Remote)

projects.title: Agile Quadruped Legged Robot
projects.tagline: Dynamic Legged Locomotion with Custom BLDC Cycloidal Actuators & Real-Time MPC Control
projects.description: An open-source 12-DOF quadruped robot platform engineered from scratch for agile locomotion across unstructured terrain. Features custom low-inertia 3D-printed/carbon-fiber legs, high-torque quasi-direct drive cycloidal gearboxes, and a real-time Convex MPC controller running on an onboard computing module.
projects.problem: Traditional commercial quadruped robots are prohibitively expensive for academic research and often utilize closed proprietary hardware and firmware stacks with high actuator backlash.
projects.objective: Engineer a high-performance, cost-effective 12-DOF quadruped robot capable of trotting, bounding, and active disturbance rejection with fully transparent hardware and software specifications.
projects.approach: Adopted a multidisciplinary mechatronic design methodology: first simulated single-leg dynamics in MATLAB/Simscape, engineered custom 6:1 cycloidal gearboxes with under 0.1 deg backlash, developed high-speed CAN FD communication between 12 joint nodes, and implemented hierarchical Model Predictive Control (MPC) and Whole-Body Control (WBC).
features: 12 high-torque quasi-direct drive brushless actuator modules with 14-bit absolute magnetic encoders
Real-time Hierarchical Convex MPC and Virtual Model Stance Controller running at 500 Hz
CAN FD multi-drop bus operating at 5 Mbps with synchronous zero-jitter joint torque streaming
Carbon-fiber composite leg linkages optimized for minimal impact inertia during swing phase
Comprehensive Gazebo simulation environment with full kinematic and dynamic URDF model
results: Achieved stable trotting at 1.4 m/s over uneven obstacles and 15-degree inclines.
Demonstrated active push recovery against 40 N horizontal impulse disturbances.
Total hardware BOM cost kept under $1,800—an 85% reduction compared to commercial research quadrupeds.

projects.title: Industrial Autonomous Mobile Robot (AMR)
projects.tagline: LiDAR SLAM, Autonomous Navigation & Precision Docking for Material Handling
projects.description: A heavy-duty autonomous mobile robot designed for internal logistics in manufacturing facilities. Integrated with dual 2D safety LiDARs, depth cameras, 3-axis IMU, and a custom suspension system capable of moving 150 kg payloads with millimetric precision.
projects.problem: Manual transport of raw materials between production cells generates bottlenecks and safety hazards in crowded factory environments.
projects.objective: Build an industrial-grade autonomous transport unit with autonomous route planning, dynamic obstacle avoidance, and battery docking.
projects.approach: Built a differential-drive robot base running ROS 2 Nav2 stack on an industrial x86 PC, interfaced with dual Sick safety LiDARs and high-power BLDC motors governed by custom STM32 motion controllers.
features: Dual 270-degree LiDAR coverage with zero blind-spot safety zones and emergency stop certification
Sub-centimeter docking capability utilizing visual AprilTag tracking and infrared guidance
Fleet management integration over secure MQTT/WebSockets with cloud dispatch dashboard
Adaptive costmap generation with dynamic obstacle speed prediction
results: Successfully navigated 1,200+ autonomous delivery cycles in a live manufacturing facility without human intervention.
Zero collision incidents recorded over 250+ operational hours.

projects.title: High-Performance FOC BLDC Servo Drive
projects.tagline: Field-Oriented Control Firmware for Brushless Actuators with CANopen over STM32G4
projects.description: A compact, high-bandwidth servo drive platform engineered around the STM32G474 microcontroller. Features Space Vector PWM, sensorless & encoder-based Field-Oriented Control (FOC), active phase-current sensing, and rigorous thermal management.
projects.problem: Commercial servo drives are bulky, expensive, and lack open CANopen / high-frequency telemetry APIs required for dynamic robotics research.
projects.objective: Design a sub-50mm round servo drive capable of delivering 30A continuous at 48V (1.4 kW peak) with full FOC control loops running at 40 kHz.
projects.approach: Engineered a 4-layer 2oz copper PCB with MOSFET half-bridges and shunt current amplifiers; wrote register-level C firmware utilizing the STM32 high-resolution timer (HRTIM) and CORDIC hardware math accelerator.
features: 40 kHz FOC current loop with sub-2µs total calculation latency using ARM Cortex-M4 DSP & CORDIC
Integrated dual AS5047P absolute magnetic encoder interface over high-speed SPI
CiA 402 drive profile implementation (Profile Position, Profile Velocity, Cyclic Synchronous Torque)
Hardware over-current, under-voltage, and thermal runaway protection circuitry
results: Achieved 96.8% electrical power conversion efficiency at 48V / 25A continuous load.
Delivered smooth torque ripple below 1.2% across 0 to 6000 RPM velocity range.

projects.title: Real-Time Edge-AI Industrial Vision Sorter
projects.tagline: High-Speed Defect Inspection & 4-Axis Delta Robot Sorter using YOLOv8 on Jetson
projects.description: An automated industrial inspection and sorting system combining deep-learning object classification with high-speed Delta robot kinematics. Detects micro-defects on conveyor parts at 120 items/minute with real-time visual tracking.
projects.problem: Manual quality inspection in manufacturing is slow, subjective, and prone to fatigue-induced errors.
projects.objective: Build an autonomous sorting cell combining sub-millimeter vision defect identification with dynamic kinematic pick-and-place tracking.
projects.approach: Trained a custom lightweight YOLOv8 nano model optimized via TensorRT for 60 FPS inference on NVIDIA Jetson; developed closed-form Delta robot kinematics on STM32 communicating over UDP.
features: 60 FPS defect detection and 6D pose estimation running locally on NVIDIA Jetson Orin Nano
Conveyor-belt linear encoder tracking synchronizing robot gripper trajectory on-the-fly
High-acceleration Delta robot arm executing pick-and-place cycles under 450 ms
Industrial Web HMI dashboard displaying defect analytics, yield rate, and live annotated video stream
results: Attained 99.4% defect classification accuracy across 10,000+ test samples.
Increased sorting throughput by 320% compared to previous manual inspection station.

mechanicalDesigns.title: Low-Backlash Cycloidal Actuator for Legged Robotics
mechanicalDesigns.tagline: High-Torque Density 6:1 Cycloidal Reduction with Integrated Crossed Roller Bearings
mechanicalDesigns.description: A custom-engineered quasi-direct drive actuator module built specifically for dynamic quadruped and bipedal robotic joints. Engineered to withstand intense impact shock loads while maintaining near-zero backlash (< 1.5 arcmin) and high back-drivability for transparent force control.
materials: Hardened Tool Steel O1 (Cycloidal Disc & Ring Pins)
manufacturingMethods: Precision Surface Grinding (Disc Faces to ±0.005 mm)
mechanicalDesigns.tolerances: ISO 2768-f; Bearing seats: k5/h6; Pin bores: H7 (+0.012/-0.000 mm)
mechanicalDesigns.problem: Standard planetary gearboxes suffer from tooth pitting under high robotic foot impacts, while harmonic drive reducers are delicate, expensive, and difficult to back-drive.
mechanicalDesigns.solution: Engineered a dual-disc cycloidal mechanism with 180-degree phase offset that balances dynamic radial forces and distributes high shock loads across multiple contact pins simultaneously.
keyFeatures: 6:1 gear reduction ratio in an ultra-compact 42 mm axial packaging envelope
Integrated custom crossed-roller bearing capable of handling 120 Nm combined radial/axial moment loads
Backlash measured under 1.2 arcminutes with > 91% mechanical torque transmission efficiency
Hollow-bore center routing shaft enabling continuous wire harness pass-through for multi-joint arms
mechanicalDesigns.feaResults: Von Mises maximum stress of 312 MPa under 60 Nm peak shock impact load (Safety factor of 1.78 on 7075-T6 aluminum yield limit).

mechanicalDesigns.title: Modular Carbon Fiber & Aluminum Quadruped Chassis
mechanicalDesigns.tagline: Ultra-Lightweight Monocoque Chassis with Internal Battery & Electronics Thermal Ducting
mechanicalDesigns.description: Structural body monocoque engineered to house onboard computers, battery pack, and power distribution boards while serving as the rigid anchor for 4 hip actuator modules.
manufacturingMethods: Selective Laser Sintering (SLS PA12 Cooling Shrouds)
mechanicalDesigns.tolerances: Waterjet profile: ±0.15 mm; CNC bolt patterns: ±0.05 mm
mechanicalDesigns.problem: Quadruped robot bodies require high torsional stiffness during trotting but must remain lightweight to conserve battery life and maintain dynamic agility.
mechanicalDesigns.solution: Constructed an interlocking carbon-fiber box structure joined by CNC aluminum corner brackets with integrated thermal exhaust channels that guide forced air over the central computing unit.
keyFeatures: High torsional stiffness (> 480 Nm/deg) preventing chassis flex under aggressive dynamic turning
Quick-release battery tray mechanism enabling battery hot-swapping in under 15 seconds
Sealed IP54 electronics compartment with silicone perimeter gaskets
Integrated vibration-isolated mounting plate for high-precision IMU state estimation
mechanicalDesigns.feaResults: Torsional deflection under 0.22 degrees under full diagonal 400 N ground reaction force test.
